E09: yes: up to 5 retries means at most 6 total attempts including the initial try.
E10: yes: paging is required only after more than 4 whole hours without acknowledgment; p is constrained to 0 or 1.

C12: yes: skew is interpreted as a nonnegative count of seconds in the future.
